name: internal-analysis
summary: Analysis agents query allow-listed PostgreSQL tables and post findings to named internal Slack channels: public and internal columns only, at most 20 rows a read, and nothing posted to a channel shared outside the organization.
protects: the agent named with --agent (required) reads and aggregates only public and internal columns (pii and secret values are withheld), and reads at most 20 rows at a time
the agent named with --agent (required) posts only to the Slack channels named with --slack-channel; without --slack-channel it posts nowhere
the agent named with --agent (required) never posts to a channel shared with another workspace or organization, read from Slack within the last 5 minutes
the agent's grant covers reads, aggregates and the table list on pc.postgres, and posts to the named channels only
excludes: what a post says: pc.slack applies the disclosure limits to its text, and a person reads the channel
who is in an internal channel: anyone in it reads the post
data scoping needs the Team edition
the limits are examples: change them in a new policy version before relying on them
grant: reads and aggregates of the connection's tables, public and internal columns only; posts to the named Slack channels

connections: a pc.postgres connection in enforce mode with a manifest that classes every column
a pc.slack connection with a bot token in enforce mode, which also provides the fact slack.channel.external
